summary: Verified mobile-friendly redesign of /compare accordion. Mobile (390x844) shows stacked-card layout with vendor, price, code, and Go button all visible within viewport — no horizontal scroll. Desktop (1280x800) retains full table with all columns. Code copy toast, form filter pills, and all data-testids work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Compare.jsx is 647 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting PeptideAccordion, VendorStrip, PromotionsStrip into separate component files for maintainability.
The 401 errors in console appear to come from an unrelated admin endpoint; not blocking but worth checking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844: expanded accordion body scrollWidth=340, clientWidth=340 (no horizontal overflow). Desktop table hidden via sm:hidden vs hidden sm:block properly. Mobile Go button bbox x=300, x+w=353 (well within 390 viewport). Copy code -> 'Code ERICA copied' toast confirmed. Form pill nasal filter works on mobile. No lint errors.
